interpret.need: Determine the total number of unique audiences associated with campaigns.
interpret.echo: How many audiences are there based on the campaign?

task.goal: List the audience size for each campaign

task_results.sql:
SELECT
    campaigns.name AS campaign,
    COALESCE(SUM(campaigns.audience_count),0)::bigint AS audience_selected

FROM (
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.organization_id,
  c.branch_id,
  c.name,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.starts_at,
  c.ends_at,
  c.source_channel,
  c.created_by_user_id,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  c.goal,
  c.objective,
  c.session_id,
  c.audience_summary,
  c.audience_count,
  c.launch_plan,
  c.launch_local_date,
  c.launch_local_time,
  c.timezone
FROM campaign.campaigns c
WHERE c.organization_id = 1000
  AND c.branch_id = 1000

) campaigns
WHERE TRUE
  AND TRUE
  AND TRUE
  AND TRUE

GROUP BY campaigns.name ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
